title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Lemon Sherbet
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Keep your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K device flowing with flavour with the Lemon Sherbet Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod plus a 10ml refill container, together delivering up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, consistent flavour. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod and refill system offers a simple and reliable way to enjoy vaping with the Dojo Blast kit, supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation technology. Lemon Sherbet captures the zesty and effervescent taste of a classic confectionery favourite. The profile opens with the sharp, citrusy brightness of fresh Lemon, which is immediately followed by a wave of fizzy, sugary sweetness on the exhale. This combination creates a lively and refreshing vape that perfectly balances tart citrus notes with a nostalgic, sugary finish. With transparent pods and a clean refill system, managing e-liquid levels is straightforward and fuss-free.
